finding: Source 2.2 reuses the exact 2.1 movie; it does not demonstrate visible change.
proposed_resolution: Publish a new export and synchronized before/after controls.
acceptance_criteria: Different actual media hash, explicit visible change list and human comparison; identical output is labeled unchanged.

finding: Broad hand influence has no semantic torso mask; registered artwork also has differing upper/lower transforms.
proposed_resolution: Separate torso/limb/hand/prop domains; use articulated shoulder-elbow-wrist control and corrective poses.
acceptance_criteria: Hand-only sweep with camera/breathing off preserves protected torso/head/prop/boots within proposed 0.5 source pixels; human anatomy/contour review approves the result.

finding: 32 flags remain: 26 silhouette and six hand; largest hand proxy step 45.829 design pixels.
proposed_resolution: Review all flags, repair or document deliberate staging without hiding original thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Every row has a reviewed edit or artistic rationale, reviewer and supporting frames; new export retains provenance.

finding: Character rendering uses a fixed 2D zoom/pivot; there is no shot graph or actual view orbit.
proposed_resolution: Add shared scene state, multiple cameras, shot timeline and genuine view selection.
acceptance_criteria: Six-shot 60 fps benchmark includes actual front/three-quarter/profile/rear views where supported; preview/export share IDs and timing.

finding: Perspective wireframes are guides; the actor is a raster cel, without surfaced/skinned 3D rendering.
proposed_resolution: Implement a rigged-asset loader, surface renderer, skinning, depth and occlusion.
acceptance_criteria: A real imported rig maintains coherent front/side/back surfaces, hands and prop occlusion during an orbit.

finding: Project fixes canvas/cel sizes and scene contacts; no shared calibrated multiview/3D manifest is consumed.
proposed_resolution: Add versioned character manifests, per-view part rigs, optional 3D rigs and declared capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Two different characters import; same identity/voice/history survive 2D/3D switches; missing modes/views remain explicit.

finding: Context export is not an entire conversation importer or durable per-character memory.
proposed_resolution: Parse JSON/CSV and reviewed text mappings; preserve accepted messages/source spans with atomic rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Message counts/hashes round-trip; Unicode/large logs/role ambiguity work visibly; model context limits never silently delete stored history.

finding: Context snapshots record reasoning_engine_executed=false; no actual text-provider conversation is executed there.
proposed_resolution: Bind implemented host/standalone API or local text-model adapters to the shared session controller.
acceptance_criteria: Real user input produces a real correctly bound reply; provider registration alone is insufficient; failures/cancellation are visible.

finding: Legacy automatic_reanimation=false; current movie is one statement and mouth motion is energy-driven.
proposed_resolution: Connect actual speech output to sample-clock-driven live performance and implemented idle/talk/gesture states.
acceptance_criteria: Several unseen replies generate new audio and fresh synchronized performance; no substitution of prerecorded demonstration; alignment capability is labeled accurately.

finding: Existing voice application/bridge do not implement the complete requested character-chat window.
proposed_resolution: Share one character/session/render core between a host panel and standalone shell.
acceptance_criteria: Both entry points run the same history-to-dialogue-to-voice/avatar test; switches, resize, restart and failures preserve state and avoid blank windows.

finding: Frozen installer remains baseline 2.0; added source is not incorporated/natively accepted.
proposed_resolution: Rebuild one packaged installer and perform clean-machine offline native acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: No separate Python/Node or first-run model download; installation, import, conversation, playback and data preservation are actually tested.

finding: 60 fps delivery is not a live benchmark; the 12-second production export took 225.26 seconds.
proposed_resolution: Separate responsive UI/render/audio from inference/export; cache and measure each backend.
acceptance_criteria: Record hardware, quality, frame-time percentiles, drops and speech latency; proposed 60 Hz presentation budget is 16.67 ms/frame with responsive cancellation.

finding: Exact anime matching was relaxed; the proposed Maelstrom comparison was skipped; technical checks do not grade art.
proposed_resolution: Use an original multishot benchmark, shared-time comparison and human composition/anatomy rubric.
acceptance_criteria: Document view coverage, pose legibility, framing, arcs, contacts, props and lighting; no fabricated studio score from hashes/PSNR.

finding: Repeated lookup failures stopped local planning and did not capture the revised product goal.
proposed_resolution: Capture available requirements/local evidence first and isolate optional external benchmarks.
acceptance_criteria: Local review proceeds when external reference lookup fails, with an actionable ledger and no unverified feature claims.
